name: Central Kentucky Sonar
old_description: Like most anglers, I started fishing as a kid.  Bluegill fishing with my dad and younger brother.  The passion has stayed with me my whole life.  Being a weekend warrior in my first boat, didn't give me enough time on the water to learn my electronics.  I didn't know where to go or who to ask for help, even though electronics were much simpler then.  So I started Central Kentucky Sonar to help people learn as much as possible with hands on teaching.
about:
Central Kentucky Sonar operates from Nicholasville, Kentucky. The business was established in 2018 by an avid angler who grew up bluegill fishing with his father and younger brother. After struggling to learn marine electronics on his own as a weekend boater, he founded the company to provide hands-on instruction for others facing the same challenge.

The company functions as a full-service marine electronics retailer. It sells fish-finding and navigation units, handles professional installation, and then provides personalized training on how to operate the equipment. The service model centers on one-on-one sessions tailored to each customer’s specific unit and fishing style, whether they are new to electronics, switching brands, or seeking to fine-tune existing settings.

The primary clientele are recreational anglers and boaters in the Central Kentucky region. Customers range from beginners needing basic orientation to experienced fishermen looking to maximize the capabilities of advanced sonar and GPS systems. The business also serves as a community partner, acting as an ambassador for the Jessamine County Homeless Coalition and a sponsor of the Jessamine County Food Pantry.

The founder started Central Kentucky Sonar because he found no local resource for learning electronics when he bought his first boat. The company differentiates itself by combining retail sales, installation, and dedicated instruction under one roof, emphasizing a personal, undivided-attention teaching approach rather than classroom-style or remote support.
